basis: Written from the published specification and established practice in the field; no new sources were read. Unreviewed.

distinguishingFeatures: Connects source records to existing company subjects by proposal, never by creating or merging subjects.
Keeps immutable intake evidence for every batch, including rejected descriptors.
Treats missing coverage as unknown, never as deletion.

may: Propose that a source record is about an existing subject.
Retry an intake with the same content and key after a lost response.
mustNot: Infer identity from a display name.
Create or merge business subjects during intake.
Treat a record missing from a feed as deleted.
Silently accept changed content under an old key.
requiresHuman: Confirming a proposed match when evidence is ambiguous.

considerations: Wrong matches merge two people's records and can expose one person's data to another.
Treating absence as deletion can erase someone's rights or history.
affectedParties: People and organizations whose records are synchronized

owners.steward: The integration owner runs synchronization; each source stays owned by its operator and each subject by its domain owner.
masterSystems: Master data hub of the subjects

items: Lexical source key kept byte-exact with its namespace.

properties.reason: Institutional or informational subject: it has no physical body to measure.

items: A synchronization record ties a source descriptor and batch to a proposed subject with evidence.
Integration of external and internal systems into one Company Dimension.

sections.whatItIs: A companion contract for a Company Dimension that connects records from qualified sources to existing company subjects by proposal, keeps immutable intake evidence per batch, and explains synchronization progress without inventing identity or deletion.

sources.title: Research record EM-XCT-08: independent provider studies, audits and reconciled findings
sources.note: Evidence behind the release; claims in the card trace to it.
